row:
Evidence-based management for musculoskeletal and sports injuries.

On this channel you will find:

🔹 Patient exercise & rehab videos
Exercises commonly used in physiotherapy to manage pain, improve strength, and support recovery.

🔹 Injury education & prevention
Practical explanations to help you understand your condition and make informed decisions about rehabilitation.

🔹 For practitioners & students
Selected episodes from the Physio Foundations podcast, exploring clinical reasoning, evidence, and professional development in physiotherapy.

We are Zuzana and Luke Perraton, a husband-and-wife team each with 20+ years’ experience in physiotherapy clinical practice, research, and university teaching.

▶️ Subscribe for new videos:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCz_Dmvd9wVxpoVN5Dpnx76w?sub_confirmation=1

🔗 Connect with us: @PerratonPhysio

⚠️ This channel provides general information only and does not replace individual assessment or advice from a qualified health professional.
